history.prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. A simplified industrial tank or reservoir system where a large input pipe feeds into a central holding chamber, which is mostly full. The output pipes are notably smaller, restricting the outward flow. Flat muted palette with a muted green accent colour, thin consistent line weight, visible depth, unlabelled, generous empty margin, minimalist layout.

style_when: the article describes one decisive moment or place — a yard at dawn, a control room, a shutdown line, a handover — that a film still could hold
prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm wide establishing shot. A sprawling intermodal shipping container yard shrouded in deep dawn haze. Towering, organized stacks of corrugated steel freight containers receding into the mist. A single strong practical light source from a tall yard lamp casts deep shadows and rim-lights the brushed metal edges. Restrained teal-and-amber palette, moody atmosphere, quiet confidence. No people, motion implied through the heavy, suspended stillness of the resting cargo. Generous negative space in the sky.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, branding, people, messy, chaotic, cartoon, 3d render, bare geometry
rationale: A cinematic still of a quiet, towering container yard perfectly captures the scale of the supply chain and the eerie, suspended reality of hoarding capital while waiting for a tariff snap-back.
subject: towering stacks of intermodal shipping containers in a quiet yard
alt_text: Tall stacks of intermodal shipping containers rest quietly in a misty rail yard under dawn lighting.
caption: Supply chain operators are building cash buffers to hedge against the looming return of suspended tariffs.
title: Tariff Truce Cash Hoard
